answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 86 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in saffron, queued in voyage, and terrace publishes the wait time. A farm of 43 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4910 identities would post 501 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
